title: Rabbi David Tawil: Life Lessons From Pirke Abot- "Assimilation"

chapters.title: Introduction to Rosh Chodesh and the Month of Kislev
chapters.about: Rosh Chodesh, women's role, and Kislev

chapters.title: Human Effort and Miracles
chapters.about: Elisha and the widow, Yam Suf, starting points for blessing

chapters.title: Jewish Identity and Assimilation
chapters.about: Assimilation, cultural challenges, statistics in America and France

summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the themes of the month of Kislev and Hanukkah, focusing on Jewish identity and the subtle challenges of cultural assimilation. He explores how modern American culture, language, and entertainment can slowly erode traditional Jewish values.
questions: What is the significance of Rosh Chodesh for women?
How does human effort relate to miracles in Jewish tradition?
Why is assimilation considered a major threat to Jewish identity?
How do American culture and sports conflict with Jewish values?
